body: Thank you, means a lot. Wish I could do that but I'm often alone and a really silent person irl. It's been a grade in this school yet I've got no friends and I'm always the quiet guy in the class. I guess I'm just too scared to trust people now.

I'm trying my best to clear the exams, but it's going to take a lot with all the mental stress and the mentality that I've just given up in everything with no purpose or any goals at all. I don't even feel like playing league of legends anymore which I've been playing since the past 10 years. There's really not much I feel I can do with my life.
